name: ecb_get_latest
description:
The most recent observation of one ECB series, by dataflow and key or shorthand indicator, from the ECB Data Portal API (data-api.ecb.europa.eu, no API key).
Returns: flow, key, series_name, description, date and value; an error when nothing is found. It looks back about 40 days, so a monthly or quarterly series (HICP, GDP, M3, unemployment) can come back with no data; use ecb_get_series for those.
Inputs: flow and key together (e.g. FM and B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV) or indicator (eur_usd, eur_gbp, eur_jpy, eur_cny, eur_chf, main_refinancing_rate, deposit_facility_rate, marginal_lending_rate, eonia, ester, bond_2y/5y/10y, hicp_overall/core/energy, gdp, m1, m2, m3, unemployment_rate); one form is needed.
For several headline values at once use ecb_get_common_indicators.
Example: {"indicator": "eur_usd"}

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Optimized for dashboard and real-time displays. Returns only the most recent value with minimal payload size.
